text:
paul: Quick sync thread 10-day micro-launch for 'Inference Playbook' webinar. Need X thread, LinkedIn carousel, A/B copy test for the benchmark post, and two seedlists (enterprise + startup). Who owns scheduling + the A/B setup?
anya: I can run scheduling in Buffer and set the A/B test for X (variants A/B pinned replies). Proposed schedule: primer 8:30am PT, main 10:50am PT, follow-up Wed 9am PT.
cam: Ill write the A/B variants. A = benefit-first, B = metric-first. Also a short pinned reply for each thread with TL;DR + CTA.
mike: Creative will export 1200x628 (X landscape), 1080x1350 (LI vertical), and a 6-slide PDF for LinkedIn carousel. Also a 3-frame GIF opener for X.
paul: Key numbers to call out: approx 30% lower inference cost and ~2x throughput at comparable p99. Legal wants the word "approx" in front.
anya: For tracking: use UTMs; example snippet Ill append: 
```
?utm_source=x_tweet&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=playbook_jul2026&utm_content=variantA
```
cam: Draft copy snippets: 
- A (benefit-first): "Ship LLM features that scale. Join our free playbook demo Tue 11am PT. Register: short.link/pb"
- B (metric-first): "Approx 2x throughput at similar p99; cut unit cost ~30%. Live demo Tue 11am PT. Register: short.link/pb"
- Pinned reply TL;DR: "Live demo 11am PT. Slides + benchmarks at short.link/pb. Seats limited."
paul: SDR ask: route registrants from social UTMs into two queues depending on seedlist: enterprise -> queue:webinar-enterprise, startup -> queue:webinar-startup. Tag = social_playbook_jul2026.
sdr-bot: Routing config acknowledged. Rule: utm_campaign=playbook_jul2026 AND seedlist=enterprise -> queue:webinar-enterprise; utm_campaign=playbook_jul2026 AND seedlist=startup -> queue:webinar-startup; tag:social_playbook_jul2026; owner_rotation:regional-sdrs.
anya: Paid amplification: growth proposed $1k. Recommendation: $700 on metric variant (B), $300 on Wed follow-up. 
paul: Approve. Also request we capture which variant drove higher MQLs. Add "variant" custom field to registration form.
cam: Will include variant param in CTA and pinned reply. Also adding 2 landing page CTAs to capture variant metadata.
mike: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood/marketing/playbook_jul_assets_v3.zip. Includes alt-text and first-slide TL;DR copy for carousel.
olivia: Legal: Ill review copy for the metric phrasing. Tag me in Buffer drafts with "needs:legal" and Ill check by EOD Mon.
anya: Scheduling checklist (for me): final copy per channel, creative crops, UTMs, paid tags, A/B setup, registration variant field, seedlists uploaded, legal approval. Ill queue drafts by Mon 3pm PT.
paul: One more: can SDRs get an auto-follow note template including variant and seedlist? That will help qualify faster.
sdr-bot: Suggested follow-up template created: "Thanks for registering via social. Quick Q: are you evaluating inference infra for an internal product or for customer-facing feature? Reply with 1 for internal, 2 for customer-facing. Owner: assigned based on seedlist."
cam: Great. Ill finalize copy, tag @anya for scheduling, and include A/B labels.
paul: Thanks everyone. Quick sync Mon 4pm PT to confirm legal + A/B setup. :rocket:
